stem.text: The diagram shows different molecules in a solution.

stem.alt: Outline drawings of four molecules labelled P, Q, R and S, in a solution.

stem.text: Which statement could explain what happens when some of the molecules are mixed together?

A.text: Molecule P forms an enzyme–substrate complex with the non-competitive inhibitor molecule Q.

B.text: Molecule Q binds to molecule P, increasing the activation energy.

C.text: Molecules R and S bind to the active site of molecule P.

D.text: Molecules S and R are the products of the breakdown of molecule P.
